name: www
description: where we were: parks unfinished work and why it stopped, so the next session picks up cold. A start band offers the project's open tasks (press 1 to 3 to fill the prompt), the system prompt carries the project's state, /idea and /todo capture with no model turn, and a background job parks what is left when the session closes. Bundles the www skill and /wrap. Requires the www CLI on PATH.

closeJob.title: Park on close
closeJob.description: When a session in a www project ends with work it did not park, a background Sonnet run parks it (about $0.05 a close at list prices).
